question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Crude
solution: The correct answer is **"Ripe."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Crude"** means something that is in a natural or raw state, lacking refinement or sophistication. (सरल और बुनियादी; अपरिष्‍कृत) • **Example**:* The method was **crude**__ but very effective.* • **"Ripe"** means something that is fully developed or matured, ready for use or consumption. ((फल, अनाज आदि) पका हुआ) __ • **Example**: *Those bananas aren't **ripe**__ yet - they're still green.* • The antonym of **Crude** is **Ripe**. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - Beastly** means something that is unpleasant or offensive, resembling a beast or animal-like. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो अप्रिय या आपत्तिजनक हो, किसी जानवर या जानवर जैसी हो) • **Option 3 - Stubble** means short, rough hair or bristles on a person's face or chin, or on a plant after being cut or grazed. (मक्‍का, गेहूँ आदि की फ़सल काट लिए जाने पर खेत में खड़ी नीचे की खूँटी) • **Option 4 - Intense** means something that is strong or extreme in degree or intensity, highly concentrated or focused. (बहुत अधिक, उग्र या गंभीर) 36:Ta84, The correct answer is **"pretty."**
